cards.etymology: A single horizontal stroke — the simplest unit.
Two horizontal strokes stacked — two counts.
Three horizontal strokes — three counts.
A mouth (口) divided — four sections.
Two strokes crossed with a hook — an ancient tally mark for five.
A roof with two legs — a house split six ways.
A horizontal stroke with a hook — an old tally mark.
Two strokes spreading outward — diverging, spreading wide.
A curved stroke with a hook — nearly a full circle, one away from ten.
A vertical stroke crossed by a horizontal — a plus sign, ten directions.
One (一) above a white (白) — a hundred white hairs on an elder's head.
Ten (十) with a slanted stroke — a thousand-fold magnification of ten.
A frame enclosing strokes — a rounded coin shape.
Grain (禾) stalks bent at harvest — one full harvest cycle, a year.
The crescent moon in simplified form.
A circle with a center dot — the sun.
Sun (日) + temple (寺) — when the temple bell marks the sun's position.
A knife (刀) dividing (八) — splitting into parts.
A vertical stroke splitting a horizontal in two — cut in half.
A cover pressing down — pinning the present moment.
Person (亻) by a burdensome load (可) — asking 'what is this?'
Two strokes — a person leaning against another, supporting each other.
A person (人) with arms spread wide — as big as you can get.
A vertical stroke splitting two tiny dots — something small, divided.
A vertical stroke through the center of a rectangle — right in the middle.
A short stroke above a line — pointing up.
A short stroke hanging below a line — pointing down.
A hand (ナ) holding a carpenter's tool (工) — the left hand at work.
A hand (ナ) bringing food to the mouth (口) — the right hand eats.
A boat (舟) stopped by a knife (刂) — halted out front.
Walking (彳) slowly (幺) with a foot (夂) — lagging behind.
Two people (比) sitting back to back — turned away from the cold north.
A shelter with hanging tendrils — a warm southern vine-covered hut.
The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木) — the east at dawn.
A bird settling into its nest — birds roost at sunset in the west.
Evening (夕) + divination (卜) — reading omens outside at dusk.
A tree (木) with a mark at the root — the origin point.
Three peaks — a mountain range viewed from afar.
Three vertical strokes — water flowing between banks.
A stream with droplets splashing — water in motion.
Flames rising from a central point — a bonfire.
A trunk with roots below and branches above.
Metal nuggets (王) in the ground — buried gold.
A seedling sprouting from the ground — earth.
Great (大) with a stroke above — what is above the great man, the sky.
Rain (雨) with lightning bolt — electric storm.
Spokes of a wheel seen from above.
Horse (馬) + post exchange (尺) — where horses were exchanged on a route.
A jewel (玉) enclosed by borders — a nation guarding its treasure.
Wood (木) building +交 (exchange) — a place of wooden structures where learning is exchanged.
Legs walking (先) past others — going ahead.
A seedling (屮) sprouting from the earth (土) — new life.
Hands (爻) guiding a child (子) under a roof — learning.
Rice steam (米 + 气) — the vital energy rising like steam.
Drops (冫冫) falling from a cloud under the sky (一).
A cave (穴) where work (工) is done — hollowed out, empty sky.
Grass (艹) changing (化) — plants transforming into bloom.
Five fingers and a wrist — the shape of a hand.
A knee and foot — the lower leg.
An eye turned on its side — the almond shape of an eye.
A square opening — the shape of an open mouth.
A figure seated gracefully — a woman.
A rice field (田) plus strength (力) — a man working the field.
A swaddled baby with arms outstretched.
A woman (女) with two dots marking her breast — a nursing mother.
A hand wielding an axe — the father providing and protecting.
Two right hands (又) clasped — hands joined in friendship.
A crossroads — moving through an intersection.
Grain (木) with people clustering underneath — people coming to harvest.
A broom sweeping toward a figure — sweeping the path home.
Gathered food (良) under a roof — food ready to eat.
Food (食) with a yawning mouth (欠) — opening wide to drink.
An eye (目) on legs — walking around looking.
A brush (聿) drawing — writing with a brush.
Words (言) + sold (売) — paying attention to what is written.
Words (言) + tongue (舌) — the tongue making words.
Words (言) + I/myself (吾) — the words that express myself.
Ear (耳) at a gate (門) — listening at the door.
Two strokes converging inward — pointing into an opening.
A foot stepping over a threshold — going out.
A tall tower on a base — towering high.
A woman (女) under a roof (宀) — a woman safe at home.
Ten (十) mouths (口) — ten generations of mouths passing stories, old.
Standing timber (立木) + axe (斤) — freshly chopped wood, new.
Long hair flowing — an elder with long hair.
Arrow (矢) + bean/small (豆) — a short arrow that hits nearby.
Big (大) with an extra dot — just a bit bigger, thick.
Thread (糸) + a field (田) — threads thin as a hairline.
Two moons (夕×2) — when the moon appears twice, time passes, things accumulate.
Small (小) + a tilting stroke — something small made smaller.
The sun (日) above a ten (十) — the sun just barely risen, early morning.
Walking (辶) with efficiency (束) — moving quickly along a path.
Walking (辶) with a sheep stuck (尾) behind — lagging slow.
A person (人) carrying a heavy load (里) — weighed down.
Cart (車) + channels (巠) — a cart with smooth wheels, light to pull.
Sun (日) + sound barrier (音) — the sun blocked, darkness.
A shelter (广) with only space inside — wide open.
Walking (辶) with an axe (斤) — approaching to chop nearby trees.
Walking (辶) a long swirling (袁) road — going far away.
Bow (弓) + silkworm (虫) + reinforcing stroke — reinforced, strong.
Two bows (弓) with ornamental endings — decorative bows, not for battle, weak.
A woman (母 modified) — recurring like a mother, every time.
Sun (日) + cut/made (乍) — the day that was cut off.
The sun rising between the reeds — early morning.
A finger pointing to the sun at its peak — high noon.
Evening (夕) with a person and a cover — tucked in for the night.
Walk (辶) + cycle (周) — cycling through the days of the week.
A tree (木) with a mark at the top — the end, the tip.
Sun (日) + feathered wings (翟) — the sun cycling on its wings.
Gathering (合) under a roof — people meeting inside.
Land god (示) on earth (土) — the shrine, then by extension a company.
Person (亻) + samurai/official (士) — to serve as an official.
A hand (又) working within (中) — a matter being dealt with.
Three tens — thirty years, a generation, the whole world.
A pig (豕) under a roof (宀) — a house with livestock.
Person (亻) + master (主) — a person established as master of a home.
A door (戸) and an axe (斤) — the place where work is done.
A mound (阝) + a city quarter (咅) — a section of the city.
Corpse/roof (尸) + at (至) — where one arrives under a roof, a shop.
A mouth (口) on legs — a stand someone speaks from.
Walking (辶) with a leader's head (首) — leading the way on the road.
Shelter (广) + to divine (占) — choosing a spot under a roof for a store.
A cloth banner (巾) on a stem — a banner marking a market.
A rice field (田) + nail/boundary (丁) — a bounded farming settlement.
Tree (木) + inch/measurement (寸) — a measured wood settlement.
Quiver (匸) of arrows + a hand — reaching into the quiver of remedies.
Hill/wall (阝) + complete (完) — a walled complete establishment.
Illness (疒) + ice (丙) — feverish chills of sickness.
Grass (艹) above pleasure (楽) — healing herbs that relieve pain.
Person (亻) + root/main (本) — the main substance of a person.
Beans (豆) + page/head (頁) — the roundness of a head.
A graceful figure (彦) + head (頁) — the distinguished markings of a face.
Stop (止) + rice (米) arranged as molars — the teeth that stop food.
A musical instrument (殸) simplified — the sound a person makes.
The shape of a human heart — the seat of feeling.
A field (田) over a heart (心) — seeds of thought planted in the heart.
Arrow (矢) + mouth (口) — shooting straight words, knowing.
Woman (女) + platform (台) — a woman standing on a platform to begin.
Thread (糸) + winter/end (冬) — thread running out at winter's end.
Person (亻) + cutting (乍) — a person cutting and shaping things.
Birds (隹×3) in a tree — many birds gathering in one tree.
A lid fitting over a mouth (口) — fitting together, combining.
Two hands (廾) lifting the gate bar (门) — opening a gate.
A gate (門) with a fastening bolt — bolting the gate shut.
Seven (七) + knife (刀) — seven strokes of the knife.
Person (亻) + official (吏) — a person put to official use.
Hand (扌) + temple (寺) — a hand holding steady like a temple.
Walking (彳) + temple (寺) — walking to the temple and waiting there.
A person (大) on top of a tree (木) — riding high.
